title: Sargon II killed on campaign in Tabal
summary: Sargon II is killed by Gurdi the Kullammaean on campaign in Tabal; Sennacherib succeeds.
description: Sargon II is killed by Gurdi the Kullammaean on campaign in Tabal; Sennacherib succeeds. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 2, row 705, p. 41; Table 3, row 705, p. 45).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 705 BC.

chronologies.note: Eponym Chronicle: Sargon killed by Gurdi the Kullammaean in Tabal; Sennacherib takes the throne on Abu 12 (August 705).
